lede: Your deck, rebuilt in the same footprint across the back of the house: two levels, {width} along the house, the upper level {step_in}" above the lower. The old deck and its brick columns come out. The new frame is TrueFrame 2x10 joists at 12" on center with joist tape, on 6x10 Douglas fir beams and 8x8 rough Douglas fir columns, each column on {footing_one}. TimberTech Vintage decking in English Walnut runs parallel to the house, with a picture frame and breaker boards so every board is one piece. Every deck board and stair tread is screwed through the face with Cortex and plugged in English Walnut. Black Impression Rail Express with vertical balusters, and an English Walnut drink rail over the posts. The stair between the levels is set into the upper level, and the face between the levels is English Walnut boards installed vertically.

roof.title: Louvered roof
roof.blurb: A black Suncoast Louvered Roof over the main section of the upper level: {roof_w} along the house by {roof_d} out, {roof_sf} SF at ${roof_rate} per square foot.
facts: Suncoast Louvered Roof, motorized, black powder-coated aluminum, over the upper level's main section
Aluminum blades, 8" wide on 8" spacing, in {roof_zones} zones with one motor each. Closed, they seal against rain and drain into the gutters; open, they turn up to 140 degrees, by remote or app
Two 6x6 aluminum posts on the deck at the rail line. They are the rail posts there; the rail panels bracket into them
House side: the eave is about 8' above the upper deck, so the roof's house side is carried on flashed brackets on the roof above it, with no posts at the house
Gutters built into the frame; the downspouts run inside the posts
An LED light strip in the gutter's light track, warm white, on the roof's remote and app
roof.note: The louvered roof has its own document with the details.

note_tail.front+right: Black mesh in zipper side tracks, with a weighted bottom bar, on the roof's remote and app. The front screen comes down inside the rail, so the drink rail stays outside it. The left end stays open, so the stair between the levels stays clear.
note_tail.front+left+right: Black mesh in zipper side tracks, with a weighted bottom bar, on the roof's remote and app. The front screen comes down inside the rail, so the drink rail stays outside it. The left screen comes down across the top of the stair between the levels; raise it to use the stair.

roof_doc.lede: A black Suncoast Louvered Roof over the main section of your upper deck: {roof_w} along the house and {roof_d} out, {roof_sf} SF. Motorized aluminum blades turn from closed to 140 degrees open. Closed, they seal against rain and drain into gutters built into the frame, and the downspouts run inside the posts. Two posts stand on the deck at the rail line and are the rail posts there. The house's eave is about 8' above the deck, so the house side is attached at the roof line above it, with no posts at the house. Suncoast builds the roof to the measured size of your deck.
roof_doc.viewer_note: The deck and the louvered roof in 3D, in a web browser. Move the sun through any day at your address, turn the louvers to any angle, and raise and lower the screens.

screens_label.front+right: Motorized screens on the front and the right end
screens_label.front+left+right: Motorized screens on the open sides

screens_blurb.front+right: Screens that come down from the frame on the front and the right end. The front screen comes down inside the rail, so the drink rail stays outside it. The left end stays open, so the stair between the levels stays clear.
screens_blurb.front+left+right: Screens that come down from the frame on the front and both ends. The front screen comes down inside the rail, so the drink rail stays outside it. The left screen crosses the top of the stair between the levels; raise it to use the stair.

what: Structural aluminum frame, beams, posts and blades, powder-coated (AAMA 2604), in black
8" blades on 8" spacing with weather stripping on every blade: closed, they seal against rain and drain into the gutters; open, they turn up to 140 degrees
A motor inside one blade of each zone (one motor for up to 150 SF): no arms, levers or pistons outside the frame
Built by Suncoast to the measured size of your deck, from measurements taken on site
gutters: A gutter runs around each zone, inside the frame; the blades drain into it and water flows freely from zone to zone
The downspouts run inside the two posts
The gutters are cleaned by hand or with a shop vacuum
screens: Gaposa motor with obstacle detection, on the roof's remote and app
Phifer mesh held in zipper side tracks; a weighted, sealed bottom bar
Rated for wind up to 65 mph; they can retract automatically in higher winds
Black mesh, in black housings and tracks to match the frame

roof_doc.deck_note: With the roof, the upper level is framed for it from the start: a column on a larger concrete caisson under each of the roof's two posts, and blocking and ties at each post base.
schedule: Suncoast measures on site and builds the roof to those measurements.
Installed after the deck is built: the roof's posts stand on the new upper level.
TBD (confirm the days and the lead time with Suncoast Denver, copy.md 2.6): About 3 working days on site for the roof, and 1 more for the screens.
